name: Goldfish Gold
oneLiner: GGBR is Goldfish Gold (I-On Digital) tracking 1/1000th of a troy ounce per token, with issuer-managed gold exposure and issuer-controlled mint/redeem contracts.
collateral: Each GGBR token represents 1/1000th of a troy ounce of gold held by the GGBR Trust: 1,000,000 troy ounces of in-situ gold from the Happy 2 claims (Pinal County, Arizona), independently verified under NI 43-101 / S-K 1300 standards by a Qualified Person, with roughly 40:1 coverage against 25,000,000 GGBR outstanding (issuer collateral page, read 2026-09-04).
pegMechanism: GGBR price tracks the LBMA Gold Spot Price in real time at 1/1000th of a troy ounce per token; supply is created and redeemed through issuer-controlled mint/redeem contracts, with physical gold redemption available through regulated precious-metals dealers and on-chain proof-of-reserve oracles for collateral verification

proofOfReserves.provider: Goldfish designated collateral wallet on Ethereum (proves only a related-party ION.au token balance versus GGBR supply; underlying in-situ gold quantity and extractability are not independently attested)

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: GGBR is a commodity claim rather than a fiat-cash claim: the whitepaper and collateral disclosure state that each token represents 1/1000th of a troy ounce of LBMA-priced gold, over-collateralized up to 5:1 by a segregated portion of I-ON Digital Corp's ION.au treasury with a perfected UCC-1 lien on the underlying mineral asset rights. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14. The claim chain is indirect (GGBR to ION.au security to an in-situ gold lien), which the title and allocation component grades; the archetype records what the token references, not how well.

sources.label: Goldfish collateral disclosure (ION.au backing, published on-chain reserve wallets)
